documentation_claims: Binance publishes daily and monthly public Spot and Futures archives.
Every published ZIP archive is accompanied by a CHECKSUM file.
Spot aggregate trades have eight documented columns.
USD-M Futures aggregate trades have seven documented columns.
Spot timestamps from 2025-01-01 onward are documented in microseconds.
Archived files may be revised after publication.
limitations: Only the 144 frozen Binance checksum URLs may receive GET requests.
No archive HEAD or ZIP payload request is permitted by this contract.
Checksum text proves publication identity, not payload quality or edge.
The schema and timestamp register is documentary and awaits payload proof.
No price, quantity, side, signal, trade, PnL, or return may be inspected.
All 144 targets and all 72 paired months must be present to pass.
A pass permits only a separately frozen one-month paired payload protocol.
No candidate, Pine, paper, Testnet strategy-order, production, or live authority is created.
